world.name: Legal Tender

decision.declined: The Annual Report roll (Swiss annual report) - beaten on audience identification; its disciplines carried in as craft, not as its look

dosageRules: No backdrop-filter anywhere: intaglio is flat ink. The inherited --glass-* tokens resolve flat (--glass-bg -> --sheet-solid, --glass-line -> --edge-silver, --glass-highlight: none, --glass-blur: 0px); header band and contact dock are opaque paper

Bronze (--gold/--gold-wash) is spent on exactly one subject: recognition - award medallions, the award metric chip, the hero award figure. Trajectory badges (Now/Returned) take the accent, never bronze
One green accent owns action, links, focus, the timeline spine, the engraving fill, and the security-thread progress bar
The still-ground rule: nothing behind the content is animated or tinted - one flat rag-paper ground on html (dark: the green-black intaglio plate #0d1712, not gray)
Dark tokens are written twice in app.css: the prefers-color-scheme block guarded by :not([data-theme="light"]) AND :root[data-theme="dark"] - the two blocks must stay byte-identical; change both
Tokens keep the NAMES of the previous world so scoped component stylesheets resolve unchanged - only values moved (--gold is bronze now; --glass-* are flat); never re-point a glass token at a blur
Every content plate carries the banknote frame: 1px --sheet-line edge, inner rule inset 7px at 5px radius, and a 2.4px --ink-faint quarter-dot seated on each corner of the inner rule

Guilloche discipline: engine-turned fills are authored SVG line geometry (counterphased curved interlace over a fine diagonal hatch) with a faint solid underlay so hairline strokes stay inked - lines as structure, never loose ornament
The No-Kicker Rule stands: nothing above a heading; plate legends and bylines go below the title, in tracked mono

Motion is additive-only: motion.js adds .js-motion and gates every hidden state; the print-in plays once under .js-motion .hero.is-playing on a proved first look (sessionStorage heroPlayed, scroll threshold, boot deadline); reduced motion restores everything
bannedPatterns: Kickers/eyebrows above headings (craft-floor ban; the No-Kicker Rule stands)
backdrop-filter, frosted fills, or any blur on any surface (The No-Blur Rule)
Bronze on navigation, action, links, badges, or decoration - bronze is recognition-only
color-mix()-dependent tints without a solid fallback (the user's review browser is an old Edge WebView)
Invented figures anywhere on the note - serials, counts, and quotes are real and derived only (The Serials Rule)
Unconditional opacity: 0 or any hiding rule not gated behind .js-motion from motion.js
Animated or tinted backdrop layers behind the content (the still-ground rule)
The before/after hero diagram - deleted at the user's word; the payment argument lives in the flagship case study
Visual design on the printed CV - it stays ATS-plain by product rule; only its on-page chrome wears the world
Contact dock, header band, back-to-top, or progress bar reaching paper (all dropped in @media print)
The phone number printed as visible text on the showcase - it travels in the contact dock's tel: href only

sheet-bg.displayName: Plate Wash (translucent chip fill, no blur)

accent-bright.displayName: Accent Bright (focus ring, hover, spine nodes)

accent-wash.displayName: Accent Wash (evidenced chips, outcome blocks, plate wash)

edge-metal.displayName: Edge Metal (collapsed to the brass hairline; no gradient metal)

glass-bg.displayName: Glass Fill (resolves FLAT to --sheet-solid; no blur)

dock-bg.displayName: Dock Fill (opaque plate face; no blur)

display.purpose: Bodoni Moda hero headline only - four clipped lines, one italic green accent line.

headline.purpose: Bodoni Moda sheet titles, each under its double rule.

body.purpose: Spectral prose, capped at the 66ch measure.

meta.purpose: Fragment Mono serials, facts, and attributions; carries all numerals with tabular-nums.

label.purpose: Fragment Mono uppercase labels, nav links, and dock actions at 0.1-0.12em tracking.

shadows.name: shadow-sheet
shadows.purpose: Every content plate: one crisp contact step, one wide paper lift. Two steps, never three.

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: Header band chrome, the contact dock, back-to-top, and the primary seal at rest.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: The single hover response under buttons, chips, and back-to-top; never coloured, never at rest.

shadows.name: plate-inner-ring
shadows.purpose: Inset double ring on the denomination plate; the medallion uses the same device in bronze (3px sheet-solid, 4px gold).

motion.name: print-in
motion.value: denomination-print 1s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) both; from opacity 0 + clip-path inset(6% 2%)
motion.purpose: The plate press: the denomination prints in one damped pass, once, only under .js-motion .hero.is-playing.

motion.name: legend-settle
motion.purpose: The plate legend settles a beat behind the numeral.

motion.name: reveal-clock
motion.purpose: Sections settle in from visible; every hiding rule gated behind .js-motion from motion.js.

motion.name: draw-y
motion.purpose: The accent spine draws down the timeline rail entry by entry; without the script it is simply already drawn.

motion.name: pulse-node
motion.value: 2.6s ease-in-out infinite; box-shadow ring in the accent at 40%
motion.purpose: Only the current role's node keeps moving - the one entry still in progress; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: security-thread
motion.purpose: Reading progress with no script and no markup; @supports guarded; hidden in print.

motion.name: theme-transitions
motion.value: View Transitions ~250ms cross-dissolve where supported; WAAPI theme-pulse 620ms from the switch; atomic swap under reduced motion
motion.purpose: Theme swap never repaints per-frame; the pulse is transform + opacity on one short-lived layer outside #app.

motion.name: hero-guard
motion.value: sessionStorage heroPlayed=1; scroll threshold; boot deadline - any miss means the hero is never armed
motion.purpose: The print never replays over a reader; a skipped visitor gets the fully printed static note, never armed-but-invisible.

motion.name: still-ground
motion.value: nothing behind the content animates or is tinted
motion.purpose: All movement lives inside the content; all depth on the plates.

breakpoints.name: xs
breakpoints.purpose: Nav strip tightens (0.5rem padding, 0.64rem labels) so every link, CV last, stays inside the mask.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Header band wraps to two rows (--header-band 3.4rem -> 6rem, scroll margin 7rem); dock centres; main grows a 7rem bottom pad; hero takes a 4.6rem dock clear zone.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Hero grid stacks; denomination plate centres at 240px; headline steps down.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Timeline gains the 10.5rem right-aligned period column; certifications balance into two columns.

material.glass-tokens: resolve FLAT: --glass-bg -> var(--sheet-solid), --glass-line -> var(--edge-silver), --glass-highlight: none, --glass-blur: 0px, --dock-bg -> var(--sheet-solid) - kept as names so scoped stylesheets resolve; never re-point at a blur
material.frame-technique: sheet::before draws the inner rule (inset 7px, radius 5px); sheet::after seats four 2.4px --ink-faint quarter-dots on its corners via radial-gradients; plate titles and the header band close with double rules (1px border + 1px inset 3px away)
material.guilloche: authored SVG patterns: engine-turn 12x7 tile of two counterphased sine waves (stroke 1, opacity .9/.55) + engine-turn-fine 3x3 tile rotated -45deg (stroke .7, opacity .45), over a solid accent underlay at 17% opacity; strokes use var(--accent) so the engraving re-inks with the theme
material.knob-metal: aged brass light #f8f3e6->#d9cdb0; green-black dark #35473b->#1b2a21; travel by transform (old-WebView review browser)

narrative.overview: The portfolio as an engraved banknote - the solo-built payment gateway earns the denomination. The hero is a note face: a Bodoni 9 at banknote scale filled with engine-turned line geometry, serialled with real figures (9 markets, 7 gateways, 491 tests), beside the legend lettering and the plate legend BUILT ALONE - END TO END. Content floats as a plate series on rag paper: every sheet carries the banknote border - an outer edge, an inner rule inset 7px, a machined quarter-dot on each corner. The dosage law: intaglio is flat ink - no backdrop-filter anywhere; the inherited --glass-* tokens resolve to flat paper, a hairline, 0px, and none. One accent (banknote green) owns action, links, focus, and the engraving; bronze marks recognition only. Direction chosen on the impeccable decision page 2026-09-27 (answer: model-pick, seed key aaa7f143), replacing the Sky Aluminum world; the hero before/after diagram was deleted at the user's word and its argument lives in the flagship case study.
keyCharacteristics: Still rag-paper ground (dark: the green-black intaglio plate, not gray) - nothing layered, nothing animated behind the content.
Plate frames everywhere: double-rule title beats, inner rules inset 7px, corner quarter-dots; the header is an opaque paper band under a double rule, not a floating capsule.
One green accent for action, links, focus, the spine, and the engraving; bronze spent on recognition only (medallions, award chips, the award figure); no blur anywhere.
Bodoni Moda for the engraved didone voice, Spectral for document prose, Fragment Mono for serials and every figure in tabular numerals.
Squared 3px registry stamps (badges, metric chips, stack tags) against full pills on all interactive chrome.

Motion is the plate press: the denomination prints once on a proved first look; sections settle from visible; hiding is additive-only behind .js-motion; the printed CV stays ATS-plain outside the system.

rules.name: The Twice-Written Rule
rules.body: Dark tokens are written twice in app.css — the guarded prefers-color-scheme block and the [data-theme="dark"] rule, byte-identical. Any token change is made in both places, always.

rules.name: The Bronze Is Recognition-Only Rule
rules.body: Bronze (--gold) is spent on exactly one subject — recognition: medallions, award metric chips, the award figure. Its rarity is what makes the medal land. Trajectory markers ("Now", "Returned") take the accent, never bronze.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a heading — no kickers, no eyebrows, no numbered wayfinding. A plate opens with its title; the plate legend and bylines go below it, in tracked mono.

rules.name: The Serials Rule
rules.body: Every figure on the note is real and derived, never typed. A banknote with a made-up serial is counterfeit.

rules.name: The Dock Clear-Zone Rule
rules.body: On a phone the note face's first viewport is never masked by the seal strip: the hero carries 4.6rem of bottom clear zone, main carries 7rem, and the dock stays hidden behind .js-motion until first movement; no-JS and reduced-motion visitors always have the dock.

rules.name: The No-Blur Rule
rules.body: No backdrop-filter on any surface, ever — intaglio is flat ink on paper. The inherited --glass-* tokens resolve flat (--glass-bg to --sheet-solid, --glass-line to --edge-silver, --glass-highlight none, --glass-blur 0px). Any new surface asking for glass gets paper instead.

rules.name: The Still-Ground Rule
rules.body: Nothing behind the content animates or carries tint — one flat rag-paper ground on html. All movement lives inside the content; all depth lives on the plates.

dos: Do write any dark token change in both places — the guarded prefers-color-scheme block and the [data-theme="dark"] rule, byte-identical (The Twice-Written Rule).
Do keep bronze on recognition only — medallions, award metric chips, the award figure; "Now"/"Returned" badges take the accent (The Bronze Is Recognition-Only Rule).
Do keep every surface opaque: fixed chrome is paper under a brass hairline; --glass-* stays resolved flat; if a style asks for blur, it is a bug (The No-Blur Rule).
Do frame new content plates with the banknote border — inner rule inset 7px plus the corner quarter-dots — and put plate titles under a double rule.
Do gate every hiding rule behind .js-motion from motion.js, restore every hidden state in the reduced-motion and print blocks, and arm the print-in only through the proved first-look guard.

Do keep the prerendered <div class="prerendered"> a direct child of #app, mirror header/dock changes in prerender.py (static_shell_header / static_contact_dock), and carry final values in markup for anything a script counts.
Do keep 44px tap floors on buttons, dock actions, and the toggle; keep figures in Fragment Mono with tabular-nums, real and derived only.
Do verify both themes at 390×844 and desktop width before calling anything done.
donts: Don't put kickers or eyebrows above headings, and don't add border-left accent stripes — both stay below the craft floor (The No-Kicker Rule stands in this world).
Don't use backdrop-filter, frosted fills, or color-mix()-dependent tints without a solid fallback — the review browser is an old Edge WebView, and this world is flat ink by doctrine.
Don't put anything animated or tinted behind the content — the ground is one flat, still surface (the still-ground rule).
Don't spend bronze on navigation, action, links, badges, or decoration — and don't spend the accent's green on recognition; each metal has one subject.
Don't invent a figure: no fabricated serials, no invented quotes (testimonials render only from real, attributed submissions), no un-derived numbers on the note.
Don't rebuild the before/after diagram — it was deleted at the user's word; the payment argument lives in the flagship case study.

Don't print the design: header band, dock, back-to-top, and cv-actions drop out in print, below-fold reveals force-restore, and the printed CV stays deliberately ATS-plain outside this system — only its on-page chrome wears the world.
Don't print the phone number as visible text on the showcase — it travels in the dock's tel: href only.
